title: Untainted adjudicator
description: The dispatched party that rules — given the original intent and the checker's output, and never the artefact itself. It names each drift against the criterion's declared `drift` statement and returns pass / warn / fail. It holds `qa-reporting` and its witness leads the criterion, because the first entry per criterion is the operative one. It does NOT hold `content-authoring`: the party that produced the artefact does not write the verdict on it, which is the whole discipline in one line.
